command: pre-registration of plan L's probe L2 (demo-selected language-prototype composition, no practice)

metrics.demos: 2 recorded successes per task on fresh_ood_pl2d (BASE 3300000) by the other policy's strongest set-d arm (G13); own-policy fallback flagged; demo 0 selects, demo 1 scores

hypotheses.H1: per policy, l2sel > zs on the 8 dev tasks x 20 episodes (exact sign test on discordant pairs, alpha 0.05)
hypotheses.H2: per policy, l2sel non-inferior to TLI with Li's hand pairs and lambda (task-level bootstrap 95% lower bound of the difference above -0.05)
hypotheses.controls: rand (seeded random no-overlap sentence) and pos (T8: no-overlap sentence whose training grasp / release is nearest demo 0's), each on l2sel's operator form; descriptive comparisons l2sel vs rand / pos
hypotheses.descriptive: offline demo-1 flow loss per arm vs zs (Li's 20 x 2 policies, 16 LIBERO-90 tasks); each operator vs zs in closed loop; part correctness g and p|g; per-repair source, span and action-mode change

metrics.selection: demo-0 flow loss only (36 frames, 4 fixed draws); object source, goal source, layer span {1-17,1-6,7-12,13-17}; TLI pair at lambda 24 then lambda {12,24,36}; no practice, no reward
metrics.states: fresh_ood_pl2 (BASE 3400000, 20 per task, never used), noise seed 13, paired
metrics.tested_arm: l2sel = per task the operator with the lowest demo-0 flow loss
metrics.written_before: any L2 flow loss and any L2 closed-loop episode
